name: ShowSky_4
short_caption: The robot opens and raises both arms wide to point toward the sky or express grand scale.
movement_description: The robot starts from a neutral posture, bringing its elbows out and hands to its chest level before raising both arms wide open and upward at a 45-degree angle. It holds this high-reaching, open-palm gesture with its head slightly tilted upward for a moment to emphasize looking toward the sky. Finally, it smoothly lowers both arms back down to its sides, returning to the neutral resting pose.
safety_notes: The robot's arms extend fully outwards and upwards. Ensure there are no low-hanging objects or visitors standing extremely close to the sides of the robot.
